embeds.title: BLHA CONSTITUTION
embeds.description: The Constitution is the controlling rules document of the Beer League Hockey Association. Managers are responsible for knowing the current rules and any formally adopted amendments.

fields.name: HOW TO USE THIS CHANNEL
fields.value: The current Constitution, formal amendments, and published rule interpretations belong here. Casual rules questions belong in **❓│rules-questions**.

fields.name: AUTHORITY
fields.value: Fantrax controls gameplay records and transactions. The BLHA Constitution controls league rules and governance.
